answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 40534 Country: Bangladesh Title: In our office ground floor we have a mosque. Is it acceptable if we pray Jumuah salah in this mosque Question: In our office ground floor we have a mosque. Is it acceptable if we pray Jumuah salah in this mosque? If not, then why, please suggest us. Answer ID: 40534 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 704/747/N=1433) If outsiders are allowed to come in the ground floor of your office to participate in Jumuah salah then it is right and lawful to establish Jumuah salah therein. But it is masnoon that Jumuah salah and other fardh salah are offered in Shariah mosque. And if the outsiders are not allowed to come there then Jumuah salah is not right there as it is a condition for Jumuah salah to be valid that the premises is open for public (izn aam). So it is mentioned in the book of Fatawa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
